name: legacy-clonk-ext
description: A language extension for the game legacy clonk
author: Fridjof Milke

legacyClonkLanguageServer.maxNumberOfPro.description: Controls the maximum number of problems produced by the server.

legacyClonkLanguageServer.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the language server.

legacy-clonk-ext.pathToC4gExecutable.description: Path to c4group executable, which is used to pack/unpack .c4* files

legacy-clonk-ext.pathToGameExecutable.description: Path to game executable, which is used to run scenarios

legacy-clonk-ext.stringTableLanguages.description: Languages your string tables ($Name$ -> StringTbl<Language>.txt) must cover, in this order, e.g. ["DE", "US", "ES"]. Empty: DE and US.

legacy-clonk-ext.typeChecks.description: Report arguments whose type the engine can never convert (e.g. an object passed where a string is expected); they fail at runtime. Turn off if it reports false positives.

legacy-clonk-ext.fieldTypes.description: Infer the types of script variables (local, static) from every value the indexed scripts assign to them (a local from its definition's scripts and obj.name = x writes, a static from all scripts). Shown on hover and used by the type checks. Needs typeChecks.

legacy-clonk-ext.objectIds.description: Track which definition an object variable holds (CreateObject(ID, ...), FindObject2(Find_ID(ID)), this, ...) so obj->F() resolves to exactly that definition's functions: hover, go to definition, return types, parameter checks, and a warning when the definition has no such function. Unknown objects behave as before. Needs typeChecks.

legacy-clonk-ext.assumeCreateSucceeds.description: Assume CreateObject, CreateContents, CreateConstruction, PlaceAnimal, PlaceVegetation and ComposeContents always give an object (type object instead of object | nil). They fail only in exceptional cases (invalid ID, the object removes itself in Initialize). Off: their results count as maybe nil (also for nilChecks).

legacy-clonk-ext.callerInference.description: Advanced, slower (the check takes about 3x as long): infer what a function's callers guarantee. A private/protected function whose name never appears in a string (Schedule, Call, ActMap, DefCore) gets its parameter types from all its call sites, and starts with Contained()/GetActionTarget()/... known to be set when every caller checked it. The engine's own guarantees (Entrance, Collection2, Contained<Com>, PhaseCall of PUSH/ATTACH/... actions, InitializePlayer crew) apply without it. Needs typeChecks.

legacy-clonk-ext.lint.description: Lint warnings the engine doesn't give: unused variables (unused-var), private functions nothing calls (unused-func), code after return/break/continue (unreachable); shown faded. Silence one with // NOLINT(code) (quick fix), // NOLINTNEXTLINE(code), // c4lint: ignore-file(code).

legacy-clonk-ext.nilChecks.description: Warn about obj->F() where obj may be nil: it comes from a function that can find nothing (FindObject, FindObject2, Contained, Contents, GetCursor, ...) and no if (obj) / if (!obj) return; guards the call. nil->F() stops the script (also with ->~); obj?->F() is nil-safe. Needs typeChecks.

legacy-clonk-ext.debugEngine.description: clonk.exe used by the script debugger (Run > Start Debugging on a scenario): it needs the debugger (/debug:<port>), which official releases don't have yet (LegacyClonk fork, branch debugger). Empty: pathToGameExecutable.

legacy-clonk-ext.runtimeLogs.description: Engine logs (Clonk.log) whose script errors show at their source lines (runtime errors with the call chain, compile errors the static check doesn't report). Empty: the game folder's Clonk.log. Watched while the editor runs; an edited script's entries disappear until the next run.

scenario.description: The scenario (.c4s folder or file) to run.

engine.description: clonk.exe with the script debugger. Default: the setting legacy-clonk-ext.debugEngine, else pathToGameExecutable.

player.description: Player file (.c4p) that joins. Default: the engine configuration's players.

cwd.description: Working folder of the engine (its Clonk.log is written there). Default: the engine's folder.

log.description: Engine log shown in the debug console. Default: <cwd>/Clonk.log.

port.description: Debugger port (/debug:<port>). Default: a free one.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop at the first script that runs.

port.description: The port of an engine started with /debug:<port>.

cwd.description: The engine's working folder (for script paths relative to it).

log.description: Engine log (Clonk.log) shown in the debug console.
